cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sign the minutes after we fill this gap. 'Discussion of my proposal' leaves rather a lot out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat first? Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll talk over dinner; you needn't write it yet. Who wanted my name out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested another presenter to save the proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, leave the pen. Tell me who you suggested while I serve.

reason: Give A a signoff role that yields meal timing and written record demands to keep B disclosing; the final request pursues the omitted replacement rather than summarizing the omission.
